svg.text: Breakout board, step 4 of 6: The two BC337s
Top view, header at the top.
Every resistor and diode lies flat: columns 9-16 of rows D-F sit under the display's connector, 4mm up. Diode stripe = cathode.
Transistors: flat face towards row F, so C-B-E reads left to right.
MOSFET adapter: on a 1x3 header in 19C-21C, lying over rows D-F; its holes 2-3-1 are source, drain, gate.
